study_scope.primary_question: Can finite-choice Qwen scores improve exact discovery when the target is in support but sound deduction derives no examples for either specialized hole?
study_scope.primary_endpoint: paired intention-to-treat exact discovery for D versus QD across five frozen seeds
study_scope.secondary_endpoint: held-out exact correctness on the frozen bounded-square oracle
study_scope.design_disclosure: The sparse task was deliberately designed and locally screened to make deduction underconstrained; D failed all five seeds before any Qwen score was observed. This is an exploratory stress test, not a confirmatory benchmark.
study_scope.gpu_gate: Run seed 101 first as a provider-contract gate. Continue with seeds 211, 307, 401, and 503 if and only if the provider contract succeeds, regardless of the synthesis outcome.
study_scope.failure_policy: Every planned cell remains in the analysis. Timeout, provider failure, invalid artifact, or non-exact training result counts as failure.

stages.description: Provider-free preflight of all five frozen D seeds before observing any Qwen score.
